blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.
blocks.zh: 通用机器人政策和语言模型代理提供互补能力,但完成一项任务还需要调整其用途以适应物理相互作用的后果. 我们研究将执行作为适应的一个中心:反馈指导当前的行动,并提供证据,以便根据固定的模型权重修订随后的决定。 我们引入了Robo Doctor,这是一个无培训框架,它将诊断、有根据的行动和持续的经验联系起来,贯穿三个修订目标。 控制手段在政策和代理人之间分配控制;干预决定何时协助,同时保留有用的政策行为;操作通过所观察到的效果来完善物理方法. 相关经验记录保留了作出决定的理由、尝试方法、结果和再利用的条件。 在54个"RoboDojo-Sim"任务条目的整理档案上,"RoboDoctor"实现了"5分"的平均得分57.10分,本土成功率为49.44%. 记录下来的相互作用说明战略的改变、选择性的更正和把握修正。 这些结论是评价系统中执行时间调整的特点;控制下的审判仍然是孤立跨周期经验贡献的必要条件。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language–action (VLA) models and world action models (WAM) have expanded the range of manipulation behaviors available from a single model ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025a ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Language-model agents add complementary capabilities in task interpretation, planning, and tool use ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Liang et al., 2022 ) . Translating these capabilities into complete task execution also requires managing their consequences: each interaction changes the conditions under which later actions must succeed. A grasp can be locally successful yet leave an object poorly positioned for the next step. Robot capability therefore depends on how available behaviors are coordinated, evaluated, and revised through physical interaction. This raises a system-level question: how can a robot use execution feedback to adapt the way it deploys existing model capabilities?
blocks.zh: 愿景-语言-行动(VLA)模型和世界行动模型(WAM)已经从单一模型中扩大了操纵行为的范围(Kim等,2024;Black等,2025a; Ye等, 2026 (英语). 语言模型代理人在任务解释、规划和工具使用方面增加了互补能力(Ahn等,2022;Liang等,2022)。 将这些能力转化为完全的任务执行也需要管理其后果:每次互动都会改变以后行动必须取得成功的条件。 抓取可以在当地成功,但留下一个对象的位置差,供下一步使用。 因此,机器人的能力取决于如何通过物理互动协调、评价和修订现有行为。 这提出了一个系统层面的问题:机器人如何利用执行反馈来适应其部署现有模型能力的方式?

blocks.en: Robot agents already incorporate environmental feedback into planning, detect execution failures, and use reflection to refine action selection ( Huang et al., 2022 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . Building on this progress, we study the decisions that arise when an agent and a continuous robot policy share responsibility for execution. A deviation may require a local correction, a different contact method, or a change in the strategy that organizes the task. These responses operate at different levels and can interfere with one another: correcting alignment may preserve a useful grasp, whereas repeatedly restoring that grasp may perpetuate an ineffective strategy. The challenge is to identify what needs revision while retaining behavior that remains useful.
blocks.zh: 机器人代理已经将环境反馈纳入规划,检测执行失败,并运用反思来完善动作选择(黄等,2022;郭等,2024;冯等,2025.). 在这个进展的基础上,我们研究当一个代理人和一个连续的机器人政策共同承担执行责任时所产生的决定. 偏差可能需要局部校正,不同的接触方法,或者改变组织任务的策略. 这些应对措施在不同层面运作,并可能相互干扰:纠正调整可能保持一种有益的把握,而反复恢复这种把握可能使一种无效的战略永久化。 挑战在于确定需要修订哪些内容,同时保留仍然有用的行为。

blocks.en: Recent embodied recursive self-improvement (RSI) systems use physical feedback to revise execution harnesses and accumulate reusable skills ( MMLab & PhysicalRSI contributors, 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Within this direction, our perspective is that execution is itself a locus of adaptation . Physical interaction serves two roles: it advances the task and provides evidence about how the available capabilities should be used. That evidence can regulate the next action and become external experience for subsequent attempts. With both policy and agent weights fixed, the adaptive state lies in control organization, intervention decisions, and the accumulated methods that inform future behavior. Preserving successful behavior is central to this process: a failure should prompt revision at the level implicated by the feedback, without discarding competence that the same interaction has demonstrated.
blocks.zh: 最近体现的递归自改进(RSI)系统使用物理回馈来修改执行用具并积累可再用的技能(MMLab & P物理RSI 撰稿人,2026;Song等,2026;Li等,2026). 在此方向下,我们的观点是,执行本身就是一个适应的地方。 物理互动有两个作用:它推进任务并提供证据,说明应如何利用现有能力。 这种证据可以规范下一步行动,成为以后尝试的外部经验。 随着政策和代理权的分量的固定,适应状态在于控制组织,干预决定,以及为未来行为提供信息的累积方法. 保持成功的行为是这一进程的核心:失败应促使反馈所涉及的层面作出修正,而不放弃同一互动所显示的能力。

blocks.en: Making this perspective operational requires connecting diagnosis to physical evidence. Recognizing a slipped grasp does not specify a stable contact, and reaching a commanded pose does not establish that the object moved as intended. Likewise, a successful correction supports a reusable lesson only under conditions justified by the observation. An alignment principle may apply in another scene even when its original displacement does not. We therefore link the reason for a decision to the attempted physical method, its observed effect, and its conditions of applicability. Reuse calls for checking those conditions and grounding the method again in the current scene.
blocks.zh: 要使这一视角发挥作用,就必须将诊断与物证联系起来。 认错不会说明有稳定的接触,而按指示摆出姿势并不能确定物体是否按预期移动。 同样,成功的纠正也支持只有在观察所证明的条件下才能重复使用的经验教训。 调整原则即使在最初的迁移情况并非如此,也可适用于另一场景。 因此,我们把作出决定的理由与试图采用的实际方法、其观察到的效果及其适用条件联系起来。 重新使用要求检查这些条件,并将方法再次置于目前的场景。

blocks.en: We introduce RoboDoctor , a framework that implements this perspective through three coupled revision targets (Figure 1 ). Harness RSI allocates control responsibility between policy and agent. Intervention RSI determines when assistance is warranted and which policy behavior to preserve. Operation RSI refines how an intended physical change is achieved. A Hybrid controller lets the policy propose primary motion while the Doctor reviews and selectively corrects it; a Direct controller assigns planning and action to the Doctor through the same grounded tools ( Su et al., 2026 ) . Observed outcomes guide selection between these controllers, and linked experience records support revision within and across episodes. Recursive self-improvement here refers to updating and reusing this external state under frozen model weights; the evaluated harness selects between predefined controllers.
blocks.zh: 我们引入RoboDoctor, 这个框架通过三个结合的修订目标(图1)来落实这个观点。 利用RSI在政策和代理人之间分配控制责任。 RSI干预决定了何时需要援助,以及需要维护的政策行为。 RSI行动改进了实现预期物理变化的方式。 " 混合控制器 " 允许政策提出主要动议,而医生则审查并有选择地纠正; " 直接控制器 " 通过同样的固定工具(Su等,2026年)向医生分配规划和行动。 观测结果指导了这些控制器之间的选择,链接的经验记录支持各集内部和之间的修改. 这里的递归自改进是指在被冻结的模型权重下更新并再用这种外态;被评价的绳带在被预先定义的控制器之间选择.

blocks.en: We evaluate RoboDoctor through a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . The selected Refinement outcomes achieve an Overall score of 57.10, compared with 49.74 during Warmup. The capability profile in Figure 1 shows that the largest gains occur in Generalization and Open instruction following, while Long-Horizon performance decreases. The accompanying examples illustrate alignment correction and grasp revision; Section 5 examines these interactions alongside a change in task strategy. The archive supports analysis of these mechanisms and their associated performance; its retrospective selection and unequal coverage do not isolate the causal benefit of cross-episode experience (Section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过54个RoboDojo-Sim任务条目(Chen等,2026年)的整理档案来评估RoboDoctor。 所选的"完善"成果总成绩为57.10分,而"温暖"期间则为49.74分. 图1中的能力简介显示,最大的收益出现在之后的通用化和开放式教学,而长视效能则会下降. 随附的例子说明了调整校正和把握修正;第5节审查了这些互动以及任务战略的变化。 档案支持对这些机制及其相关业绩的分析;其追溯性选择和不平等的覆盖面并不孤立跨周期经验的因果关系(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (i) a training-free execution framework that connects control allocation, selective intervention, and physical operation as coupled targets of adaptation; (ii) an experience mechanism that links diagnosis, method, outcome, and applicability to guide subsequent use of fixed model capabilities; and (iii) a 54-task empirical analysis combining aggregate outcomes with recorded evidence of how execution decisions change.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) 无培训的执行框架,将控制分配、选择性干预和物理操作作为结合的适应目标联系起来;(二) 将诊断、方法、结果和适用性联系起来的经验机制,以指导随后使用固定模型能力;(三) 将综合结果同记录的执行决定如何变化的证据结合起来的54个任务经验分析。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Learned robot policies provide the manipulation capabilities on which execution-time adaptation can operate. Diffusion Policy models multimodal action distributions for visuomotor control ( Chi et al., 2023 ) . Octo, OpenVLA, and π 0 \pi_{0} develop generalist robot policies ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025b ) , while π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} uses heterogeneous co-training to extend generalization to new environments ( Black et al., 2025a ) . World action models connect action generation to prediction of physical evolution: DreamZero jointly models future video and actions ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , and PrismWAM separates semantic context from depth-based physical state ( Xin et al., 2026 ) . We study adaptation in how a trained policy is used, evaluating frozen PrismWAM; transfer to other policy families remains unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 已学到的机器人政策提供了操作能力,执行时间适应可以以此运作。 传播政策模式 用于粘接器控制的多式行动分配(Chi等,2023年) Octo, OpenVLA, and π0\pi_{0}开发通俗主义机器人政策(Ghosh等,2024;Kim等,2024;Black等,2025b),而π0.5\pi_{0.5}则使用相异的协同训练来将通俗化推广到新的环境(Black等,2025a.). 世界行动模型将行动生成与物理演化的预测联系起来: 梦 0联合模拟了未来的视频和行动(Ye等,2026年),而PrismWAM将语义上下文与深度物理状态相分离(Xin等,2026年). 我们研究如何采用经过培训的政策,评估被冻结的棱晶水系;向其他政策家庭的转移仍然没有计量。

blocks.en: Robot agents organize model capabilities into task-directed behavior. SayCan, Code as Policies, and VoxPoser connect language reasoning to robotic affordances, programs, and spatial action representations ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) . Inner Monologue incorporates environmental feedback into planning ( Huang et al., 2022 ) ; REFLECT explains failures from multisensory experience summaries ( Liu et al., 2023 ) ; and DoReMi monitors plan–execution misalignment to support recovery ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . Reflective Planning uses imagined future states and reflection to refine VLM action selection at test time ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . We build on feedback-driven execution to study assistance to an existing continuous policy: which behavior to preserve, when to replace a proposal, and whether the correction addresses the task’s limitation.
blocks.zh: 机器人特工将模型能力组织成任务导向的行为. SayCan, Code as Politics,和VoxPoser将语言推理与机器人支付能力,程序和空间动作表现联系起来(Ahn等,2022;Liang等,2022;Huang等,2023). 内部独白将环境反馈纳入规划(Huang等,2022年;REFLECT解释多感经验摘要(Liu等,2023年;DoReMi监测员计划-执行错误以支持恢复(Guo等,2024年)。 反射 规划利用所想象的未来状态和反思来完善测试时的VLM动作选择(冯等,2025. 我们以反馈驱动的执行为基础,研究对现行持续政策的援助:要维护什么行为,何时取代建议,以及纠正是否解决了任务的局限性。

blocks.en: Embodied RSI extends execution-time reasoning by revising the system that generates subsequent behavior. Its adaptive state can take several forms. PhysicalRSI and RegenHarness revise execution harnesses and the rules connecting context, routing, and recovery ( MMLab & PhysicalRSI contributors, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . EmbodiedRSI combines hypothesis-guided experimentation with code–skill co-evolution ( Song et al., 2026 ) ; Embodied Turing Machines develops a shared stateful code library that executes without a VLM or VLA in the loop ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . EmbodiRSI instead uses failure feedback to target corrective data collection and successive policy training ( Lang et al., 2026 ) . RoboDoctor places adaptation in control allocation and external experience while keeping both model weights fixed. The evaluated harness makes a discrete controller selection; within that controller, accumulated evidence informs intervention decisions and physical methods. This mechanism implements a bounded form of robot RSI.
blocks.zh: Embody RSI通过修订生成后续行为的系统来扩展执行时间推理. 它的适应状态可以有多种形式. 物理RSI和RegenHarness修改了执行手段和连接上下文、路由和回收的规则(MMLab & 物理RSI 撰稿人,2026;Wang等,2026)。 EmbodyRSI将假说指导实验与代码-技能共演化(Song等, 2026年;Embody Turing Machines开发了一个共享的状态代码库,在循环中执行时没有VLM或VLA(Hu等, 2026年). EmbodiRSI则使用故障反馈来瞄准纠正数据收集和相继的政策培训(Lang等,2026. ). RoboDoctor将适应放在控制分配和外部经验中,同时保持两种模型重量固定. 所评价的用具可以选择独立的控制器;在该控制器内,积累的证据为干预决定和物理方法提供了依据。 这种机制执行一种有界限的机器人RSI形式.

blocks.en: For fixed-weight agents, external experience lets an earlier interaction inform later behavior. ReAct interleaves reasoning and action, Reflexion retains verbal feedback, and Voyager accumulates executable skills ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . In robotics, RoboICL studies control through in-context demonstrations and interaction memory ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while GPT-Policy organizes demonstrations and execution feedback into context for VLM-based control ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . EmbodiedEvo distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons, acquired in a task-specific scene and then frozen for execution in new scenes ( Li et al., 2026 ) . We focus on the physical evidence that makes a lesson applicable: its diagnostic trigger, the policy behavior to retain, the attempted operation, and the observed effect.
blocks.zh: 对于有固定重量的剂,外部经验允许更早的相互作用为后期行为提供参考. ReAct interleaves 推理与动作,Reflexion保留了口头反馈,而Voyager积累了可执行技能(姚等,2022;申等,2023;王等,2023. 在机器人方面,RoboICL通过内文演示和交互记忆研究控制(Liu等,2026年),而GPT-政策则根据基于VLM的控制组织演示和执行反馈(Cheng等,2026年). 健壮 Evo将物理反馈分解成可重复使用的代码"技能"和"诊断教训",在任务特定场景中获得,后被冻结后被放入新场景中执行(Li等,2026年). 我们侧重于能够提供教训的物证:其诊断触发器、保留的政策行为、未遂操作和观察到的效果。

blocks.en: 3 RoboDoctor
blocks.zh: 3个机器人医生

blocks.en: 3.1 Execution-Time Adaptation with Frozen Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 采用冻结模式执行-时间调整

blocks.en: RoboDoctor adapts the use of fixed models through physical feedback. Figure 2 shows how control allocation, selective intervention, and grounded operation connect current observations to experience retrieval and update. Control allocation determines who directs execution, intervention determines what policy behavior to preserve, and operation determines how to achieve and verify a physical effect. Experience links these decisions to their observed consequences and conditions for reuse.

blocks.en: 3.2 Harness RSI: Allocate Control Responsibility
blocks.zh: 3.2 利用RSI:分配控制责任

blocks.en: The first decision is which model should direct task execution. Useful local policy motion may support the task, while an ineffective task strategy can require agent-led planning. The two branches in Figure 2 instantiate these alternatives. In Hybrid , the policy proposes primary motion and the Doctor determines what to release or correct. In Direct , the Doctor chooses the interaction strategy and issues all motion through grounded tools. Both modes use the same sensory and actuation interface.
blocks.zh: 第一个决定是哪个模式应指导任务的执行。 有益的地方政策动议可能支持这项任务,而无效的任务战略则需要由代理人主导的规划。 图2中的两个分支即刻将这些替代品进行分解。 “混合”政策提出主要动议,由医生决定释放或纠正什么。 在Direct中,医生选择交互策略,并通过被禁用的工具来发布所有动作. 两种模式都使用同一种感官和活性界面.

blocks.en: When the policy supplies primary motion, adaptation requires deciding which behavior to preserve and when assistance is warranted. We separate policy proposal from physical execution: a rollout returns A t A_{t} and a robot-only forward-kinematics (FK) preview without moving the robot. The Doctor relates this candidate motion to current RGB-D observations, measured poses, and experience. It seeks an action-relevant reason to assist, such as a changed object location or an impending alignment mismatch, while retaining useful aspects of the interaction.

blocks.en: The resulting observation tests the intervention decision. Releasing a proposal may expose a missed failure; a correction may restore alignment or disturb a stable grasp. These events can be recorded as evidence for revising later assistance, while autonomous successes identify behavior worth preserving (Section 3.5 ). Thus the decision to intervene depends on both the current proposal and experience from earlier outcomes. The FK preview supports reasoning about intended robot motion; the physical effect of either branch must be established through execution.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的观察对干预决定进行了检验。 放弃提案可能暴露出错失的失败;更正可能恢复对齐或扰乱稳定的把握. 这些事件可以被记录为修改后期援助的证据,而自主的成功发现值得保留的行为(第3.5节)。 因此,干预的决定既取决于目前的建议,也取决于以往结果的经验。 FK预览支持关于预期机器人运动的推理;任何分支的物理效果都必须通过执行确定.

blocks.en: 3.4 Operation RSI: Ground, Test, and Revise Physical Methods
blocks.zh: 3.4 RSI行动:地面、测试和修订物理方法

blocks.en: An intervention decision identifies a change to make; operation determines how to realize and verify that change. The same requirement applies when Direct plans a task action. The Operation RSI module in Figure 2 organizes both types of agent-issued action into grounding, action, and verification. The pouring example distinguishes an alignment correction from the subsequent observation of liquid transfer. The Doctor grounds visible surfaces from image pixels and depth, then uses measured end-effector poses and current head or wrist views to construct a contact method. A grounded surface point is a localization reference, not necessarily a valid finger contact or end-effector target. The method specifies approach, contact region, wrist orientation, gripper timing, motion sequence, and the role of the other arm.
blocks.zh: 干预决定确定要作出的改变;操作决定如何实现并核实这种改变。 当直接计划一项任务行动时,也适用同样的要求。 图2中的 " RSI行动 " 模块将两种由代理人发布的行动组织为地面、行动和核查。 倒灌的例子区分了对齐修正与随后对液体转移的观察. Doctor从图像像素和深度平出可见的表面,然后使用测量到的终端效应器姿势和当前头部或手腕视图来构建一种接触方法. 被固定的地表点是本地化的参考,并不一定是有效的指接触或最终效果目标. 该方法规定了取向,接触区域,腕向,抓取时间,运动顺序,以及另一臂的作用.

blocks.en: Execution provides evidence for retaining or revising this method. The Doctor compares the command, achieved robot motion, and observed object interaction. Failure to reach a target directs attention to motion or configuration; reaching it while the object slips suggests revisiting the contact method. It can revise the relevant choice, for example by changing the gripper closing axis and checking retention with a short lift before transport. End-effector and joint-space tools support these revisions. Hybrid retains the five-step per-call limit; Direct can allocate longer budgets to clear travel and shorter ones to contact-sensitive motion.
blocks.zh: 执行为保留或修订这种方法提供了证据。 医生比较了命令,实现了机器人运动,并观察到物体相互作用. 未能到达目标会引导注意力到运动或配置上;在物体滑动时到达它会建议重温接触方法. 它可以修改相关的选择,例如通过改变夹心收缩轴并检查在运输前用短升力来保持. 终端效应器和联合空间工具支持这些修改。 (d) 直接可分配较长的预算,用于清空旅行,缩短预算,用于敏感接触的运动。

blocks.en: Task progress remains subject to the same verification. In Direct , a live plan tracks subtasks and observed progress, while separate notes preserve detailed evidence. Later observations can reopen a subtask if its result is disturbed. In both modes, an operation is retained when its observed effect supports the intended interaction and reconsidered when later evidence contradicts that assessment. Persistent experience carries the method and its supporting evidence into subsequent decisions.
blocks.zh: 任务进展仍然受到同样的核查。 在Direct 中,一个活计划跟踪子任务和观察到的进展,而单独的注释保存了详细的证据. 后期的观测如果结果被扰动,可以重新打开子任务. 在这两种模式中,当一项行动观察到的效果支持预期的相互作用时,即予以保留,并在后来的证据与该评估相矛盾时重新考虑。 持续的经验将这种方法及其佐证证据带入以后的决定。

blocks.en: 3.5 Experience: Turn Physical Feedback into Reusable Methods
blocks.zh: 3.5 经验:将物理反馈转化为可再利用的方法

blocks.en: A correction changes the current physical state; retaining its evidence can change how a later action is chosen. Experience provides this link between execution and adaptation. A lesson connects the reason for a decision, the behavior worth preserving, the attempted method, and its observed effect. Its applicability is limited by that evidence: achieving local alignment, for example, does not establish that the subsequent pour succeeded.
blocks.zh: 更正会改变当前物理状态;保留其证据会改变选择后一动作的方式. 经验提供了执行与适应之间的这种联系。 一个教训将决定的原因,值得保留的行为,尝试方法,及其所观察到的效果联系起来. 其适用性受到这一证据的限制:例如,实现局部调整不能证明随后的调整成功。

blocks.en: In Hybrid , records contain an event type, triggering evidence, policy state, attempted method when applicable, and outcome. Policy state distinguishes observations, proposed or executed actions, and measured or previewed FK. Operation fields describe timing, tools, contact technique, and a stopping condition. Linked diagnosis and operation entries associate the evidence for intervention with the attempted physical method. The experience panel in Figure 2 links a mouth–rim alignment cue to a lateral correction that preserves the grasp, with local alignment and subsequent pouring verified separately. The schema distinguishes autonomous policy success, policy failure, and intervention. A policy-success record specifies the observed object interaction, success evidence, and applicability; other records require the attempted operation and stopping condition. Failed attempts remain evidence about when a method should be revised.
blocks.zh: 混合式记录包含事件类型、触发证据、政策状态、适用情况下的尝试方法和结果。 政策状态区分了观察,建议或执行的行动,并测量或预览了FK. 操作区描述时机,工具,接触技术,以及停止状态. 相关诊断和操作条目将干预证据与尝试的物理方法联系起来。 图2中的经验面板将口-边对接提示与保持把握的平面校正联系起来,并分别核实局部对接和随后的倒灌。 方案区分了自主政策的成功、政策失败和干预。 政策成功记录规定了观察到的对象交互,成功证据,以及适用性;其他记录要求尝试操作和停止条件. 失败的尝试仍然是何时应修订某一方法的证据。

blocks.en: The updated Hybrid snapshot accompanies subsequent observations and is exported at episode termination. The Doctor consults this document as context, checks applicability, and recomputes action targets from fresh geometry. The retrieval and update paths in Figure 2 connect retained diagnostic cues and physical methods to subsequent execution. For the pouring case in Figure 4 (b), the reusable method is to check mouth–rim alignment before deepening a tilt while preserving a stable grasp. The required offset must be recomputed for the new scene, and successful local alignment leaves pouring to be verified separately.

blocks.en: Direct consolidates task lessons after termination in an action-disabled summary turn. It combines applicable prior lessons with new methods, failures, and unresolved questions; the host attaches native validity, score, and success. The next episode reads this experience before planning, establishing current object poses and completed subtasks anew. The loop closes when a retained lesson informs another decision and that decision produces fresh evidence for revision. Both modes therefore support adaptation through external state under fixed model weights, without guaranteeing that each revision improves performance.
blocks.zh: 直接将任务经验在终止后合并为行动障碍摘要。 它将可适用的先前的教训与新的方法、失败和尚未解决的问题结合起来;东道主附带本土有效性、分数和成功。 下集在规划前阅读了这一经验,确定了当前对象的姿势并重新完成了子任务. 当保留的经验教训为另一项决定提供参考,而且该决定产生新的修订证据时,循环就会结束。 因此,两种模式都支持在固定模型权重下通过外部状态进行适应,而并不保证每次修订都会提高性能.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 实验评价.

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate performance on 54 task entries from RoboDojo-Sim across five capability dimensions: Generalization, Precision, Long-Horizon, Memory, and Open instruction following. Generalization comprises 12 standard and 12 randomized entries, while the remaining dimensions comprise 8, 8, 6, and 8 tasks, respectively. Our evaluation uses the category mapping and reference leaderboard archived on 2026-10-20. We use PrismWAM as the underlying policy ( Xin et al., 2026 ) . The local archive combines multiple source runs for which a uniform agent version, checkpoint, and inference budget are not established.
blocks.zh: 我们评价来自RoboDojo-Sim的54个任务条目的绩效,涉及5个能力层面:通用、精密、长视、内存和以下开放指示。 一般化包括12个标准条目和12个随机分录条目,而其余尺寸则分别包括8个,8个,6个和8个任务. 我们的评价使用2026-10-20存档的分类映射和参考领导板. 我们以棱镜WAM为基本政策(Xin等,2026年). 本地档案集成多源运行,未为此建立统一的代理版本,检查站,推论预算.

blocks.en: We divide the evaluation into two stages: Warmup, covering iterations 0–2, and Refinement, covering iterations 3–8. Warmup already incorporates Doctor assistance and experience updates and therefore characterizes the initial stage of the system rather than an unassisted policy or a baseline without memory.
blocks.zh: 我们把评价分为两个阶段:温暖,涵盖0–2和完善,涵盖重复 3–8 (英语). 温暖已经包括了医生的协助和经验更新,因此是该系统初始阶段的特点,而不是没有记忆的无协助政策或基线。

blocks.en: An outcome is considered valid if it is complete, explicitly marked as valid for evaluation, and associated with a finite native score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Valid outcomes with zero scores are retained. The archive includes score-based selection among candidate outcomes, retaining the highest valid score with deterministic tie-breaking. Because selected outcomes may originate from different source runs and memory histories, the stage comparison characterizes the archived results rather than a prospectively controlled treatment effect.

blocks.en: We compare against the three highest-scoring published agent entries, HexaShell-Preview ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , WorldScape-R 2 SI ( Manifold AI Team, 2026 ) , and EmbodiedEvo ( Li et al., 2026 ) ; the leading WAM entry, VPP2 ( Guo et al., 2026 ) ; PhysicalRSI ( MMLab & PhysicalRSI contributors, 2026 ) as a related adaptation approach; and GPT-6-Astra as a general-purpose agent reference. All reference scores are obtained from the archived public leaderboard ( RoboDojo Team, 2026 ) . Although these methods share the same aggregation convention, their interaction budgets, run-selection procedures, and configurations are not matched. The comparisons therefore contextualize overall performance but do not isolate the effects of individual components.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个最高的 公布的代理条目,六 Shell-Preview (Gao等,2026年),WorldScape-R 2 SI (Manifold AI Team,2026年),和EmbodyEvo (Li等,2026年);领先的WAM条目VPP2(Guo等,2026年);物理RSI(MMLAb和PhysicalRSI的出品人,2026年)作为相关的适应方法;GPT-6-Astra作为通用的代理参考. 所有参考分数均取自存档的公共领跑板(RoboDojo Team,2026.). 虽然这些方法共用相同的汇总惯例,但其互动预算、预选程序和配置不相匹配。 因此,这些比较对总体业绩进行背景分析,但不孤立各个组成部分的影响。

blocks.en: Table 1: Overall performance on RoboDojo-Sim. Scores and native success rates follow the benchmark’s five-dimension aggregation across 54 task entries. Reference values are published leaderboard results, while RoboDoctor values summarize selected local outcomes. Evaluation protocols and interaction budgets are not matched.
blocks.zh: 表1: RoboDojo-Sim上的整体表现. 得分率和本土成功率遵循基准的五分制汇总,涵盖54个任务条目。 参考值是被公布的领导板结果,而RoboDoctor值则总结了选定的局部结果. 评价协议和互动预算不匹配。

blocks.en: 4.2 Aggregate Performance and Capability Profile
blocks.zh: 4.2 综合性能和能力简介

blocks.en: The overall score increases from 49.74 in Warmup to 57.10 in Refinement, corresponding to a gain of 7.37 points. Figure 3 (a) places these stage-level scores alongside the published reference results. The native success rate increases from 40.83% to 49.44%, a gain of 8.61 percentage points (Table 1 ). HexaShell-Preview leads the archived public leaderboard with a score of 53.18 and a success rate of 46.85%. Refinement exceeds these values by 3.92 points and 2.59 percentage points, respectively, whereas Warmup remains below them. The Refinement score also exceeds those of WorldScape-R 2 SI, EmbodiedEvo, and VPP2 by 10.52, 12.02, and 17.84 points, respectively. These differences should be interpreted in light of the protocol differences described above.
blocks.zh: 总分从Warmup的49.74分增加到了Finalment的57.10分,相当于7.37分的得分. 图3(a)将这些阶段分数同公布的参考结果放在一起。 本地的成功率从40.83%上升到49.44%,增长8.61个百分点(表1)。 HexaShell-Preview以53.18分的得分和46.85%的成功率领先于存档的公共领导板. 精确度分别超过这些值3.92分和2.59分,而温和度仍然低于这些值. 完善分数还分别以10.52分,12.02分和17.84分相较于WorldScape-R 2 SI,EmmiformEvo和VPP2分. 这些差异应根据上述协议差异加以解释。

blocks.en: Improvements vary across capability dimensions (Table 2 ). Generalization and Open improve by 9.48 and 21.35 points, respectively, while Precision and Memory improve by 4.06 and 3.61 points. The gains thus extend across dimensions involving instruction following and precise physical execution. Precision reaches 47.60, compared with 43.03 for VPP2 and 12.65 for GPT-6-Astra in the reference snapshot. However, the Memory score of 77.50 remains below HexaShell-Preview’s 84.53 and EmbodiedEvo’s 79.40; the Open score of 50.52 also trails HexaShell-Preview’s 57.97. Long-Horizon performance decreases from 54.58 to 52.92. The aggregate improvement therefore coexists with persistent limitations in extended task execution. Moreover, the benchmark’s Memory dimension evaluates a designated set of tasks and does not independently measure the contribution of our experience mechanism.
blocks.zh: 不同能力层面的改进各不相同(表2)。 一般化和开放分别提高9.48分和21.35分,而精密和记忆则提高4.06分和3.61分. 因此,这些收益涉及在实际执行之后的指示和准确执行。 精度达到47.60分,而参考快照中的VPP2为43.03分,GPT-6-AStra为12.65分. 然而,77.50的记忆分数仍然低于HexaShell-Preview的84.53分和EmbodyEvo的79.40分;50.52的公开分数也低于HexaShell-Preview的57.97分. 长视野性能由54.58降至52.92. 因此,总体改善与长期任务执行的持续限制同时并存。 此外,基准的记忆层面评价了一套指定的任务,并不独立衡量我们的经验机制的贡献。

The overall score is the equally weighted mean of the five capability scores. Reference rows report published values; the final two rows summarize selected local outcomes.
blocks.zh: 表2:跨能力层面的业绩。 Gen.表示标准分数和随机分数的等加权平均值. 总分是5个能力分数的等加权平均值. 参考行报告已公布的数值;最后两行总结了选定的本地结果.

Figure 3: Aggregate performance and variation across tasks. (a) Overall scores for RoboDoctor during Warmup and Refinement and for published reference methods, using the equally weighted mean of five capability scores.
(b) Changes in task-level mean score from Warmup to Refinement across all 54 entries, ordered from the largest decrease to the largest increase: 24 improve, 20 decline, and 10 remain unchanged. Annotations highlight representative gains and a regression. RoboDoctor scores summarize selected local outcomes; reference methods use different evaluation protocols, so the comparison does not isolate the effects of individual components.
blocks.zh:
图3:各项任务的总体业绩和差异。 (a) 使用5个能力分数的等加权平均数,在温暖和完善期间为机器人医生和公布的参考方法打总分。
(b) 从Warmup到Refinement的所有54个条目的任务级平均分数变化,顺序从最大减少到最大增加:24个改进,20个减少,10个保持不变。 说明突出了代表性收益和倒退。 RoboDoctor分数总结了选定的局部结果;参考方法使用不同的评价协议,因此比较不会孤立单个组件的效果.

blocks.en: 4.3 Task-Level Variation and Interpretation
blocks.zh: 4.3 任务层面的变化和解释

blocks.en: Figure 3 (b) orders the 54 task entries by the change in their mean score from Warmup to Refinement, revealing substantial variation underlying the aggregate improvement: 24 tasks improve, 20 decline, and 10 remain unchanged. The annotated gains include Align Blocks, which improves from 0 to 100, and Build Tower, which improves from 30 to 100; Insert Tubes also improves from 40 to 80. At the negative end, Play Xylophone and Match and Pick from Conveyor both decline from 100 to 50. These heterogeneous changes motivate a closer examination of the physical decisions associated with individual outcomes.
blocks.zh: 图3(b)通过从Warmup到Finement的平均分数变化来命令54项任务条目,显示总体改进背后的巨大差异:24项任务有所改善,20项下降,10项保持不变。 附加说明的收益包括从0到100改进的Align Blocks和从30到100改进的Build Tower; 插入管也从40到80改进. 在负一端,Play Xylophone和Match以及Pick from Conveyor都从100降至50. 这些千差万别的变化促使人们仔细审查与个别结果有关的实际决定。

blocks.en: The stage comparison jointly reflects additional interaction, experience revision, route selection, and differences among source runs. It therefore does not isolate the contribution of any individual component, including memory. In the following section, we analyze recorded cases to characterize how the framework modifies physical execution. Establishing the causal contribution of each mechanism requires matched experiments with controlled routes, seeds, and interaction budgets.
blocks.zh: 阶段比较共同反映了额外的交互,经验修订,路由选择,以及源跑的不同. 因此,它并不孤立任何单个组成部分的贡献,包括记忆。 在下一节中,我们分析记录的案件,说明框架如何修改实际执行。 确定每种机制的因果作用需要配有可控路线、种子和互动预算的实验。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis of Execution Changes
blocks.zh: 5 执行情况变化分析

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates execution changes at the three revision levels through the initial situation, the revised interaction, and the observed result. Align Blocks illustrates a change in task strategy; Pour Liquid into Cup illustrates a targeted correction that preserves an existing grasp; and Build Tower illustrates a revised grasp verified before placement. We analyze the visible transitions in these examples to distinguish the role of each revision level.
blocks.zh: 图4显示通过初始情况、订正互动和观察到的结果,三个修订层面的执行变化。 组合块说明任务战略的改变; 将液体倒入杯中,说明有针对性地改正,保留现有把握; 建塔显示在安放前核实的订正把握。 我们分析这些例子中的明显转变,以区分每个修订层次的作用.

blocks.en: 5.1 Harness: Revising the Interaction Strategy
blocks.zh: 5.1 频率: 修订互动战略

blocks.en: Figure 4 (a) contrasts an unaligned configuration from Warmup with supported pushing in a later Direct episode. In the revised interaction, the set square remains supported on the table while the two grippers contact spatially separated points along its edge, highlighted by circles. The final view shows the blocks aligned along the tool.
blocks.zh: 图4(a)对比了来自Warmup的不协调配置与后一直接剧集中支持的推力. 在修改后的互动中,设定方块仍然被支持在桌面上,而两个抓取器沿它的边缘接触空间分离点,由圆圈突出. 最后视图显示沿工具对齐的块.

blocks.en: The change concerns how the tool is used to organize the task: the later strategy combines table support with coordinated contact from both grippers. This illustrates the role of Harness RSI in allocating control to an agent-led interaction strategy when the preceding execution has left the task unresolved.
blocks.zh: 变化涉及如何使用该工具来组织任务:后一战略将桌子支持与两个抓取器的协调接触结合起来. 这说明在前一次执行未解决任务时,Harness RSI在将控制权分配给代理人主导的互动战略方面的作用。

blocks.en: 5.2 Intervention: Correcting Alignment While Preserving the Grasp
blocks.zh: 5.2 干预:在保持平衡时纠正对齐

blocks.en: Figure 4 (b) shows a bottle held with its mouth laterally offset from the cup. The Doctor applies the illustrated one-step lateral correction while maintaining the grasp. The policy then resumes tilting and pours into the cup before withdrawing the bottle.
blocks.zh: 图4(b)显示一瓶装有口的瓶子从杯子上横向抵销。 医生在保持控制力的同时,采取一步骤的横向纠正。 政策随后恢复倾斜并倒入杯子后再取出瓶子.

blocks.en: This sequence illustrates selective assistance at the level of alignment. The correction preserves the grasp that supports the ongoing manipulation, allowing the policy to continue the pouring motion. The case highlights the role of Intervention RSI in identifying a local mismatch and correcting it while retaining useful policy behavior.
blocks.zh: 这一顺序表明在协调一级有选择地提供援助。 校正保留了支持持续操控的把握,使得政策能够继续倒注运动. 该案凸显了 " 干预 " 倡议在查明当地不匹配现象并纠正其同时保留有用的政策行为方面的作用。

blocks.en: 5.3 Operation: Revising and Verifying the Grasp
blocks.zh: 5.3 行动:修订和核查格拉斯普

blocks.en: Figure 4 (c) shows a progression from slippage to an end-face grasp, followed by a test lift and placement. The revised contact changes how the gripper holds the green block. During the test lift, the block remains between the fingers; the final view shows it placed on the supporting structure.
blocks.zh: 图4 (c)显示从滑行到取出一面,然后是测试升降和放置。 修改后的接触方式改变了抓取者如何持有绿色块. 在测试升起期间,块留在手指之间;最后的视图显示它放在了支撑结构上.

blocks.en: The test lift provides an intermediate check of the revised contact before placement. This illustrates the role of Operation RSI in modifying the physical method and assessing its observed effect. Grasp retention during this check supports proceeding with the manipulation, while the subsequent placement provides separate evidence of progress toward the task objective.
blocks.zh: 测试升降机在投放前提供经过修改的接触器的中间检查. 这说明了 " RSI " 行动在修改物理方法并评估其观察到的效果方面的作用。 本次检查期间的Grasp保留支持进行操纵,而随后的放置则提供了实现任务目标的进展的单独证据.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Recorded execution changes across three RSI levels. (a) Harness RSI: an unresolved Warmup attempt is contrasted with supported tool pushing in a later DIRECT episode; the dashed divider separates episodes. (b) Intervention RSI: the Doctor corrects bottle–cup alignment while preserving the grasp, after which the WAM pours and withdraws the bottle. (c) Operation RSI: the Doctor revises a slipped grasp and verifies retention with a test lift before WAM-led placement. Blue labels indicate WAM actions or outcomes; purple labels indicate Doctor actions, outcomes, or diagnosis. Frames show selected moments within each episode.
blocks.zh: 图4:在三个区域情报系统层面记录的执行变化。 (a) 利用RSI:在后来的DIRECT插曲中,未解决的Warmup尝试与支持的工具推力形成对比;破碎分机将插曲分开. (b) 干预RSI:医生在保留控制器的同时纠正了瓶-杯对接,然后WAM倒出并取出瓶子。 (c) RSI行动:医生在WAM引导的安置前,用测试升降机修正一个滑动的抓取并核实保留。 蓝色标签表示WAM动作或结果;紫色标签表示医生动作,结果,或诊断. 框架显示每集中选定的时间 。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The three revision targets distinguish failures that require different responses: reallocate control, change an intervention decision, or revise the contact method. Their connection through experience is useful only if the retained lesson accurately reflects execution. A plausible command or achieved robot pose does not certify stable contact, and visible progress need not satisfy the native task predicate. Schema validation makes records inspectable but does not establish their truth. Perceptual errors, incorrect diagnoses, and overgeneralized lessons can therefore persist across decisions.
blocks.zh: 三个修订目标区分了需要不同响应的故障:再分配控制,改变干预决定,或者修改接触方法. 只有保留的经验教训准确地反映执行情况,通过经验进行联系才有用。 可能的命令或实现的机器人姿势不能证明稳定的接触,可见的进展不需要满足原生任务上游. Schema验证使记录可以检查,但不能确定其真实性。 因此,认知错误、不正确诊断和过度概括的教训可能持续存在。

blocks.en: The cases demonstrate strategy changes, selective correction, and feedback-driven operation revision. The aggregate results characterize the selected runs, including regressions. Neither alone establishes the causal benefit of cross-episode experience. Retrospective selection, unequal coverage, and differing source histories limit attribution. A prospective study should compare persistent and reset experience under matched controllers, configurations, seeds, and interaction budgets. The same design should compare fixed Hybrid , fixed Direct , and Warmup-based routing.
blocks.zh: 这些案件显示出战略变化、选择性纠正和反馈驱动的操作修订。 综合结果是选定运行的特征,包括回归。 两者都无法单独确定跨周期经验的因果关系。 追溯性选择,覆盖范围不均,来源历史不同,限制了归属. 一项预期研究应在相应的控制器、配置、种子和互动预算下比较持续和重置的经验。 同一设计应比较固定混合式、固定直通式和以温带为基础的路线。

blocks.en: Training-free adaptation still consumes agent inference, policy calls, and environment interaction. Short execution horizons can improve observability while increasing latency; the present archive lacks a consolidated cost analysis. All results are in simulation, and transfer to other policies or physical robots is unmeasured. Bounded actions limit motion before renewed observation, but do not provide collision avoidance or a formal safety guarantee.
blocks.zh: 无培训的适应仍然需要代理人推论、政策呼吁和环境互动。 短期执行前景可以提高可观察性,同时增加耐久性;目前的档案缺乏综合成本分析. 所有的结果都是在模拟中,转移到其他政策或物理机器人上是没有测量的. 受约束的行动在重新观察之前限制运动,但没有提供避免相撞或正式的安全保障.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: RoboDoctor studies how existing model capabilities can be adapted to a task through physical interaction. With policy and agent weights fixed, it connects control allocation, selective intervention, and operation revision through experience that retains both a method and its supporting evidence. This makes execution a source of adaptation: observed effects inform what to preserve, what to revise, and what can guide a later attempt. The RoboDojo-Sim archive shows a higher aggregate Refinement score alongside concrete strategy changes and local corrections, with regressions that expose remaining limitations. The next experimental priority is to measure when revised experience improves subsequent execution under matched configurations and interaction budgets.
blocks.zh: RoboDoctor研究如何通过物理交互使现有的模型能力适应某项任务. 政策和代理人权重固定后,它将控制分配、选择性干预和操作修正联系起来,通过经验保留一种方法及其佐证。 这就使得执行成为了适应的一个来源:观察到的效果为保存什么、修改什么以及指导以后的尝试提供了信息。 RoboDojo-Sim档案显示,在具体战略变化和地方矫正的同时,综合改进得分较高,回归情况暴露出其余的局限性。 下一个试验优先事项是衡量订正经验在相应的配置和互动预算下改进后续执行的情况。

blocks.en: Appendix A Runtime Contracts and External Experience
blocks.zh: 附录A 运行时间合同和外部经验

blocks.en: The implementation separates policy proposal from physical execution. policy_rollout validates a finite H × 14 H\times 14 array and gripper values in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , requests a robot-only FK preview, and returns with zero physical steps. policy_continue requires the current proposal identifier and executes an unmodified prefix, capped at the controller’s execution limit. Direct-tool interventions in Hybrid require an existing proposal and a step budget from one to five. A new observation clears the old proposal. These host-side checks enforce the protocol independently of whether the agent’s diagnosis is correct.
blocks.zh: 执行将政策建议与实际执行分开。 政策滚动验证一个有限度 H×14 H\times 14 阵列和抓取值在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 中,请求一个只使用机器人的 FK 预览,并以零物理步骤返回. policy_ continue 需要当前建议标识符并执行一个未修改的前缀,封顶在控制器的执行限制下. 在 " 混合 " 中的直接工具干预需要现有提案和从一个到五个的分步预算。 新的观察澄清了旧的建议。 这些主机侧检查可以独立执行协议,与代理的诊断是否正确无关.

blocks.en: The current RSI controller caps released prefixes at 16 steps, even if a backend advertises a longer execution horizon. The bundled PrismWAM preview configuration advertises 32-action predictions and a 24-step backend horizon; the host’s 16-step cap determines what a single Hybrid release can execute. This distinction prevents backend defaults from being mistaken for the applied controller limit. The current preview backend uses four past RGB frames at stride four plus the current frame; early missing frames repeat the earliest observation. These implementation settings are not evidence that every archived run used an identical checkpoint or history configuration.
blocks.zh: 目前的RSI控制器封盖以16个步骤发布了前缀,即使后端广告的执行范围更长. 捆绑的PrismWAM预览配置广告发布32动作预测和24步后端视野;主机的16步封顶决定了单一混合放行可以执行什么. 这种区分防止后端默认值被误用为应用控制器限制. 目前的预览后端使用4个上行的RGB框架外加当前框架;早期缺失的框架重复了最早的观察. 这些执行设置并不能证明每个存档运行都使用了相同的检查点或历史配置.

blocks.en: Table 3: Evidence contracts for grounded action. These checks distinguish levels of support; none replaces the final native task outcome.
blocks.zh: 表3:有根据行动的证据合同。 这些检查区分了支持的级别;没有哪一个可以取代最终本土任务结果.

blocks.en: The experience document contains a schema identifier, version, task, latest iteration, and two blocks. Diagnosis entries retain observation references, RGB-D and robot state, action status (proposed versus executed), measured versus previewed FK, failure or success evidence, and the associated intervention when present. Operation entries retain timing, tools, technique, stop condition, observed outcome, and any referenced policy method and its adaptation. An object-interaction description can include the target object, acting arm, interaction type, contact region, approach direction, end-effector orientation, gripper sequence, motion sequence, observed success evidence, and applicability conditions. Unknown geometry remains qualitative or unknown. These fields make a lesson inspectable; they do not mechanically prove the truth of its natural-language interpretation.
blocks.zh: 经验文件包含一个计划标识符,版本,任务,最新的迭代,以及两个块. 诊断条目保留了观测参考文献,RGB-D和机器人状态,动作状态(建议与已执行),相对于预览的FK,失败或成功的证据进行测量,以及在场时的相关干预. 操作条目保留时间、工具、技术、停止状态、观察到的结果以及任何参考的政策方法及其调整。 对象交互描述可以包括目标对象,演绎臂,交互类型,接触区域,走近方向,最终效果方向,抓取顺序,运动序列,所观测到的成功证据,以及适用条件等. 未知的几何仍然具有定性或未知性. 这些领域使课程可以检查;它们不能机械地证明其自然语言解释的真实性。

blocks.en: The Direct controller keeps a current plan in TODO.md and detailed evidence in NOTES.md . Its post-episode consolidation is action-disabled. The host appends the native outcome and distinguishes a completed model summary from an evidence fallback. The next episode receives prior lessons as reference material, while current progress, object poses, and absolute coordinates must be reconstructed from its own observations. This differs from simply continuing the previous episode’s task state.
blocks.zh: 直接控制器在TODO.md中保留了当前计划,在Notes.md中保留了详细证据。 它的集成后整合是动作障碍. 主机附加了原生结果,并区分完成的模型摘要和倒置的证据. 下集获得之前的教训作为参考材料,而目前的进展,对象所呈现的,绝对坐标必须从自己的观察中重建. 这与仅仅延续上一集的任务状态不同。

blocks.en: Grounding maps native-image pixels to observed surface points. Wrist depth is measured along the camera axis and is re-queried after movement. Both end-effector and joint-space commands specify the waiting arm explicitly. Gripper commands take effect together with motion from the first step; the supplied guidance therefore separates final alignment from closure when necessary. Direct can use up to 150 steps for coarse motion on a confidently clear route, whereas Hybrid interventions retain the hard five-step cap. Guidance about contact regions, test lifts, arm roles, and viewpoint changes is supplied before interaction and should not be presented as knowledge newly discovered in every run.
blocks.zh: 将本地图像像素定位到观测到的地表点. 手腕的深度沿相机轴被测量出,在移动后再进行再加压. 终端效应和联合空间指令都明确指定了等待臂. Gripper命令与第一步的运动一起生效;因此所提供的指导将最终对齐与必要时关闭区分开来. 直接可以使用多达150个步骤,在自信明确的路线上进行粗放运动,而混合干预则保留了硬的五步上限. 关于接触区域、测试升降机、臂部作用和视角变化的指导意见是在互动之前提供的,不应作为每次运行中新发现的知识提出。
